title: لاعب ينهي كل إنجازات لعبة GTA VI على Xbox
label: تقرير

sources.name: Destructoid, Someone got every achievement in GTA 6 on the Xbox, and all it took them was 152 hours, 28 Nov 2026 19:37Z (headline only, page not readable)

footage: Official video from the resolver (https://www.playstation.com/en-ae/games/grand-theft-auto-vi/): None

angle.why_now: Destructoid reported on 28 Nov 2026 that a player earned every GTA VI achievement on Xbox in 152 hours.
angle.what_it_means_here: A concrete completion time for a game everyone is playing; only the headline figures are confirmed.

spoken: ذكر موقع ديستركتويد (Destructoid) أن لاعبًا حصل على جميع إنجازات GTA VI على Xbox. وبحسب الموقع، استغرق الأمر 152 ساعة فقط.
